# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_GET_VERSION::response_t (the WALLET one),
#         src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:2563-2572 -> { version u32, release bool }.
#         NO status/untrusted, and NO current_height/target_height/hard_forks -- those belong to the
#         DAEMON's get_version (node/get_version.json). Both daemons answer a method called
#         `get_version` with DIFFERENT shapes, which is exactly why fmonero-mock takes --role.
# `version` IS WALLET_RPC_VERSION = (WALLET_RPC_VERSION_MAJOR << 16) | WALLET_RPC_VERSION_MINOR with
#         MAJOR 1 and MINOR 31 (:49-52) = (1 << 16) | 31 = 65567. DESIGN.md §5 renders it as
#         status.wallet.rpc_version = "1.31": a consumer must unpack it as major = v >> 16,
#         minor = v & 0xffff. Reading 65567 as a version number renders nonsense.
# THIS IS THE ONLY SOURCE OF status.wallet.rpc_version, and it is a COLD-PATH call, cached 60 s in
#         state.json -- so that field is null until the first cold pass, which §5's own table says.
# IT IS ALSO THE DOCTOR'S wallet_rpc_reachable PROBE (§7.1, under a 5 s deadline) and half of
#         wallet_rpc_auth, which requires an AUTHENTICATED get_version to return 200. Run the mock
#         with --auth to exercise that half.
# `release` IS true FOR AN ARCH extra/monero BUILD: it comes from the same version tag as
#         MONERO_VERSION_FULL (src/version.cpp.in:4), which node/get_info.json carries as
#         "0.18.5.1-release".
